In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires "regulation" and "statute" respectively have the same meaning as in the Constitution ; "the Constitution" means the Constitution of the University contained in the Schedule to this Act; "University" means Universiti Brunei Darussalam established and incorporated by this Act.
The provisions of the Constitution shall, upon the appointed day, take effect and have the force of law.

(2) All notices and other written communications shall, if left at the office kept and maintained under subsection (1 ), be deemed as having been duly served upon or delivered to the University or such officer or authority to whom they may have been addressed. . 5. OF THE UNIVERSITY
A student shall not be admitted to any course of study in the of University unless he has satisfied the entry requirements prescribed for the of study.

(1) The registered students of the University, other than external students or non-graduating students or postgraduate diploma students or Association higher degree students, shall constitute a body to be known as Universiti Brunei Darussalam Students' Association (hereinafter in this Constitution referred to as "the Students' Association").

(2) The Students' Association, its constituent bodies and student bodies shall be governed and administered in accordance with the provisions prescribed by statute or regulations or their respective constitution provided that no such constitution or amendment thereof shall come into force unless and until approved by the CounciL

(3) The Council may impose and collect from the registered students and any other class of students such fees as the Vice-Chancellor may determine for the benefit of the Students' Association and its constituent bodies, and the fees may be applied in such manner as the Council thinks fit for the purpose of the Students' Association and its constituent bodies.

(4) For the purpose of this section "registered student" means a is following a full-time course leading to a first degree or a diploma, not being a postgraduate diploma, or a certificate of the University provided that a student shall cease to be a registered student for of this section if he has passed the final examination of his course for graduation unless the Vice-Chancellor authorises in writing that such student, if he is a member of the Students' Representative Council (hereinafter referred to as the "SRC"), may continue to be a registered student within the meaning of this section until the election of a new SRC in the following academic year or for such lesser period as the ViceChancellor may determine.

(I) Notwithstanding section 46, it shall be lawful for not less than of ten registered students of the University, with the prior approval of the Council and subject to such terms and conditions as the Council may specify, to establish a student body consisting of students of the University for the promotion of a specific object or interest within the University.

(2) The Council may, on the advice of the Vice-Chancellor, require any such student body established under this section to be affiliated to the Students' Association subject to such terms and conditions as the Council may specify. (1) A Convocation for the conferment of degrees shall be held or as often as the Chancellor may direct, on such date as may be approved by the Chancellor.

(2) In the absence of the Chancellor or of a Pro-Chancellor who is authorised for this purpose by the Chancellor, the Vice-Chancellor shall preside over a Convocation.

(3) The Procedure of Convocation shall be prescribed by statute.

(3) The Disciplinary Committee may delegate any of its disciplinary functions, powers or duties to any member of the staff or officer of the or any board of members of staff or officers of the University, in respect of any particular member of the staff or officer of the University or in respect of any class or category of members of the staff or officers of the University provided that(a) the member of the staff or officer of the University or the board delegated with such functions, powers or duties shall carry out, exercise and discharge the functions, powers or duties under the direction and control of the Disciplinary Committee which shall have the power to review, rescind or vary any decision or finding of such member of the staff or officer or such board ; and

(b) no delegation shall be made under this subsection as to enable a member of the staff or officer of the University to any disciplinary authority or to be a member of a board may exercise any disciplinary authority over a member of the staff or officer who is superior to him in rank. ( 4) The Disciplinary Committee shall have no jurisdiction in respect of the Chancellor, the Pro-Chancellor or the Vice-Chancellor.
